decisions.answer: The summary aligns with this decision. It explicitly frames the work as benchmarking watermark robustness and inversion behavior of FLUX.1-dev versus SD 2.1 under matched configurations, and it reports that FLUX has better latent reconstruction on clean images but loses separability under attacks, while SD 2.1 maintains robust, prompt-agnostic separation. It also attributes FLUX’s weaker robustness under attack to architectural and training differences (MM-DiT, rectified flow objective, stronger prompt dependence), which directly supports the comparative benchmarking goal.
decisions.notes: The summary repeatedly emphasizes comparative robustness and inversion behavior between FLUX.1-dev and SD 2.1, matching the stated benchmarking decision.
